text:
Nora (AE): SylvanBank emailed a list they want before POC kickoff: SOC2 bridge or report, a signed pentest/vuln attestation, a short KMS/HSM statement, asset inventory for scans, and a firm-ish dedicated pricing for a 3-month trial. They also asked whether we can guarantee EU data residency for the POC.
Imran (Solutions Eng): For dedicated provisioning our standard lead time is 10 business days; accelerated 5 days for an extra fee. I can draft a timeline and capacity assumptions.
Lena (InfoSec): We have a 2025 third-party VA and a remediation tracker. They want a one-page signed attestation confirming the assessment within 12 months. We can provide that with assessor name and scope (external/authenticated). No raw findings.
Harper (Legal): I can sign the attestation once Lena posts wording. Keep language tight: dates, assessor, scope, remediation status. If they request notarization or bespoke wording, that'll add time.
Kai (Customer Success): On scans: we allow scoped customer scans under NDA, with a defined window and IP allowlist. I'll draft a one-page scan rules doc.
Nora (AE): They explicitly requested EU-only hosting for the POC. Can we do an EU region-only dedicated pool?
Imran (Solutions Eng): Yes, EU region is possible but depends on available hardware. If they require specific GPU types in EU, add 1-2 weeks. I'll note assumptions.
Lena (InfoSec): KMS/HSM statement: we can provide a description of supported models (customer-managed KMS, HSM-backed providers) and confirm we support customer-managed keys. If they want a vendor attestation for HSM, infra needs to confirm.
AuditBot: Evidence ticket created: https://redwood.internal/audit/requests/SB-2026-019 (owner: Lena, due: 2026-03-30) :memo:
Nora (AE): Action items:
- Lena: draft signed vuln/pentest attestation + redacted remediation summary (EOD)
- Imran: EU-only deployment diagram + provisioning timeline + price assumptions (tomorrow)
- Kai: POC scan rules and asset inventory template (today)
- Harper: legal review and sign-off on attestation when posted
Imran (Solutions Eng): Sample timeline I'll include in reply: Day 0 - SOW signed; Day 1-3 - EU infra prep; Day 4-8 - GPU pool allocation & testing (accelerated fee); Day 9 - POC kickoff (estimate).
Nora (AE): I'll reply to SylvanBank asking for NDA signee for scan permission, their required GPU profile, and whether EU residency is a hard requirement. I'll attach a secure share link for artifacts.
Harper (Legal): FYI: if they want SOC2 full report and it's restricted, provide bridge letter instead and offer SOC2 access under an NDA.
Kai (Customer Success): I'll also include contact points and escalation steps for the POC.
Nora (AE): Thanks team, I'll send the reply and update this thread with customer feedback. :white_check_mark:
